project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
engine/Dockerfile:157
Detected docker image with no explicit version attached. Images should be tagged with an explicit version to produce deterministic container images -- attach a version when using `FROM <image>`.
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): engine/Dockerfile:157 FROM rules references the internal stage defined at line 111 of the same Dockerfile, not a registry image; internal stages cannot carry a version tag

mechanical_context.path_class: container image build definition (shipped as the scanner engine image)
mechanical_context.source_excerpt:
127 | # seeded scan at build time bakes it (spike §4, engine-spec §5).
  128 | RUN set -e; \
  129 |     mkdir -p /seed; \
  130 |     printf 'resource "aws_s3_bucket" "b" {}\n' > /seed/main.tf; \
  131 |     trivy fs --scanners misconfig --skip-db-update /seed || true; \
  132 |     rm -rf /seed; \
  133 |     test -d /opt/trivy-cache/policy/content
  134 | 
  135 | FROM trivy-data-core AS trivy-data-full
  136 | # java-db: only needed for JARs lacking a resolvable pom; excluded from core
  137 | # (spec §7.2.1).
  138 | RUN trivy image --download-java-db-only
  139 |
